text: The Golden Drop stage is Crumble Dungeon (크럼블 던전): the whole collection against the Holy Golden Drop (황금갓방울) in a timed run scored on damage, ranked daily and weekly per server.
detail: One key per run; the 40 highest-power cookies deploy first and the rest replace the dead; no formation, pets or manual control; up to a minute on the clock, ending early if every cookie dies. No power penalty is reported.

text: Highest documented score: 379.3G at 15.58G total power (스미노프TFT, 2026-09-28), then 325.9G at 10.10G (전치, 2026-09-27), 244.7G at 6.62G (2026-09-17), 221.4G at 9.23G (VART, 2026-09-26) and 219.5G at 7.26G (섬영's weekly best, 2026-09-15).
detail: All screenshots or video. Text-only claims reach 350G (server 1) and 250G (VART). dungeon-runs.json has every run.

text: Every top run is the same engine: captain Milk with the top ATK, Pomegranate's beam routed down a chosen ATK order, and a packed formation Milk reaches early.
detail: The orders differ: Milk, Scorpion, Figure, Brightseeker, Macaron, Melon Soda for the 379G run; Milk, Brightseeker, Scorpion, Figure, Macaron, Cheesecake for the 325.9G and 221.4G runs; Milk then Macaron and Figure for ND러너.

text: What you leave out matters as much as what you bring: chargers, summoners and Projectile Speed recipients go to Lv.1, and Bari must never be used.
detail: dungeon-exclusions.json lists them with reasons; EOG measured +42% on one account from benching Oven Wanderer and Cool Mint.

text: Cheesecake changed sides on 2026-09-10: excluded while its buff erased Milk's stacks, kept (sixth in ATK) once the stronger stacked buff won.
detail: Lime followed the same path in the 379G author's lineup.

text: Gear is an arena-style damage preset; a move-speed line helps Milk arrive.
detail: Skill Haste, Skill AMP, crit, damage reduction; no accuracy or focus. One account went from 50-60G to 75.4G on a move-speed preset that showed less power.

text: Runs swing by tens of G, so records come from retries.
detail: 90-150G on one account, about 150-188G for ND러너; rewards pay the day's and the week's best, so players spend every key.
